## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`, investigation Step 3)

Both spot checks landed complete before the handoff; this is their read (raw first). Run 6: electron side, n = +3.2×10¹², B 0 → 10 T. Run 7: hole side, n = −1.2×10¹², B 10 → 0.3 T ride-down. Both at sr1 sensitivity 50 µV (5.05 kΩ FS at the measured 9.9 nA bias), τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, dwell = blocking ramp + 3 s driver settle (= 10 τ, settling floor met at every point). Calibration: run 5 (`cnp-and-dline-calibration`).

"""Runs 6-7 raw view: SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`).
Run 6: electron n = +3.2e12, B 0 -> 10 T (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above), sr1 50 uV.
Run 7: hole n = -1.2e12, B 10 -> 0.3 T ride-down, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV.
Gain-divided Rxx = (sr1_X/1) / (sr0_X/-1e6) from the TSV, no background removal."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels


def spot_trace(rid):
    r = run(rid)
    gains = {c.cid: c.gain for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / gains["sr0"]            # measured drain current, A
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / gains["sr1"]) / I      # signed Rxx, ohm
    o = np.argsort(B)                            # run 7 descends; sort ascending
    return B[o], R[o], I[o], r


R_FS_50UV = 50e-6 / 9.9e-9  # 50 uV sensitivity at the measured ~9.9 nA bias = 5.05 kOhm

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.5, 3.8))
for a, (rid, lab) in zip(axs, ((6, "run 6 — electron, n = +3.2e12, D = 0"),
                               (7, "run 7 — hole, n = −1.2e12, D = 0"))):
    B, R, I, r = spot_trace(rid)
    print(summarize_run(r))
    a.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    a.set_xlabel("B (T)"); a.set_ylabel(r"$R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)"); a.set_title(lab, fontsize=10)
    print(f"run {rid}: complete={not r.interrupted}; I_bias {np.median(np.abs(I))*1e9:.2f} nA; "
          f"R(B~0) {np.median(np.abs(R[:10])):.0f} Ohm; max|R| {np.abs(R).max():.0f} Ohm "
          f"= {np.abs(R).max()/R_FS_50UV*100:.0f}% of the 50 uV full scale (no clipping)\n")
fig.tight_layout()

"""Runs 6-7 frequency read: sdh_onset (per-tone onsets, harmonic pairing, clip
guard via r_full_scale) + sdh_fft in 1/B over a cutoff ladder, against F_L and
the fs_count forward model (hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0.py,
u_D = 0; semi-quantitative -- trust partition/topology, not absolute F)."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

MODEL = {  # fs_count_b0: (F_L, ABAB pair, ABCA singleton) at the spot densities
    6: dict(F_L=33.09, abab=(7.31, 25.78), abab_m=(0.027, 0.061), abca=33.1),
    7: dict(F_L=12.41, abab=(6.54, 5.86), abab_m=(0.032, 0.074), abca=12.4),
}

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.5, 4.0))
for a, rid in zip(axs, (6, 7)):
    B, R, I, r = spot_trace(rid)
    mdl = MODEL[rid]
    print("=" * 72)
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=R_FS_50UV)
    print(f"RUN {rid}:  F_L = {mdl['F_L']:.1f} T")
    print(on.summary())
    # FFT stability ladder: cutoff at onset and above (residual-background check)
    for co in (max(on.onset_b, 0.3), 0.5, 0.8):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(co, float(B.max())), log=False)
        a.plot(f, spec[0] / np.nanmax(spec[0]), lw=0.8, label=f"cutoff {co:.2f} T")
    a.axvline(mdl["F_L"], color="k", ls=":", lw=1.2, label=f"F_L = {mdl['F_L']:.1f} T")
    for F, ls in zip(mdl["abab"], ("--", "-.")):
        a.axvline(F, color="tab:red", ls=ls, lw=0.9)
    a.set_xlim(0, mdl["F_L"] * 1.55); a.set_xlabel("F (T)"); a.set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm)")
    a.set_title(f"run {rid} SdH FFT — red: ABAB model pair, dotted: F_L", fontsize=9)
    a.legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()

# Luttinger / partition arithmetic on the run-6 candidate pair (electron side)
f1, f2, FL = 7.1, 22.1, MODEL[6]["F_L"]
print("\nrun 6 candidate pair: 7.1 + 22.1 = "
      f"{f1+f2:.1f} T = {(f1+f2)/FL:.2f} x F_L; partition {f1/(f1+f2):.2f}/{f2/(f1+f2):.2f} "
      f"(ABAB model at n=+3.2e12: {7.31/33.09:.2f}/{25.78/33.09:.2f})")
print("run 7 candidate pair: 4.7 + 6.6 = "
      f"{4.7+6.6:.1f} T = {(4.7+6.6)/MODEL[7]['F_L']:.2f} x F_L (model pair 5.9/6.5 -- near-CNP balanced regime)")

**Read (runs 6–7).**

**Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T) — clean two-tone constellation, decisive for the fan design but not yet for the call.** A strong light tone at **7.1 T** (SNR ≈ 40 at the record's low edge — onset *censored*, ≤ 0.3 T) with harmonics at 14.1 / 29.5 T, and a tone at **22.1 T** (onset 1.36 T, SNR 37). The 22.1 T tone is flagged `~3×7.1`, but discarding it as a harmonic breaks the partition sum — exactly the trap the investigation names (the ABAB ratio drifts through 3× with density): **7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 T = 0.88·F_L** with partition **0.24/0.76**, against the ABAB model's 0.22/0.78 at this density — i.e. an ABAB pair at a global density scale of 0.88, inside the lever-arm prior (0.8–1.2). Fork, to be decided on n-dependence: (a) ABAB pair (heavy tone follows its own Onsager curve, diving light tone at low n), vs (b) single 7.1 T pocket + 3rd harmonic (22.1 tracks 3×f₁ exactly). The remaining low-F censored tones (3.0, 4.2, 5.1, 9.5 T) sit near the residual-background band and don't sharpen across the cutoff ladder — treated as background leakage, not pockets, pending the fan.

**Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T) — the predicted near-CNP exception regime, not decisive.** Crowded set: 4.7 and 6.6 T (sum 11.3 = 0.91·F_L; model ABAB pair 5.9/6.5 — close and balanced), plus unassigned 8.5 and 12.3 T and harmonic combs. Beat-like and unresolvable at this density per the investigation's stated low-|n| exception; the hole side reaches only |n| = 1.27×10¹² inside the gate limits, so it cannot be pushed into the separated regime.

**Both sides tell a consistent global-scale story (~0.88–0.91), and both show multi-tone content — no clean ABCA singleton on either side so far.** Side call for Step 4: **electron** — lower onset (≤ 0.3 T vs 0.71 T), separated tones, and design densities |n| ≥ 2×10¹² reachable (up to +3.27×10¹² on the D = 0 line). Handed to the fan: B_lo = 0.3 T (censored onset lower bound), tone band to Nyquist ≤ 33 T (coherent content observed up to 32.4 T, ≤ 7% noise-floor level above 36 T), sensitivity 50 µV (worst corner measured directly by run 7: 587 Ω at |n| = 1.2×10¹², 10 T = 12% FS), settling τ = 0.3 s.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — the stacking-call dataset

> **05:30** · landau-fan-vti electron: n +3.2->+1.2e12 (141 pts) at D=0, B 10->0.3 T uniform-1/B (269 rows, Nyq 41.3 T, dF 0.31 T), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 1.2 s; pre-ramp 0->10 T then fan rides home to 0.3 T · **ETA ~23:00** (≈17h30m)

**Why this fan (investigation Step 4, inheriting run 6/7 spot checks — see ana).** Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹²) left a fork the n-dependence decides: 7.1 + 22.1 T sum to 0.88·F_L with an ABAB-like 0.24/0.76 partition, but 22.1 ≈ 3×7.1 — real heavy pocket vs 3rd harmonic. Across the fan a harmonic tracks 3×f₁ exactly, a real heavy tone follows its own Onsager curve (model: light tone dives 7.3 → 1.1 T over n = 3.2 → 1.2×10¹² while the heavy tone stays near F_L) — the trajectories diverge unmistakably. Hole side stays a preview (run 7): gate limits cap it at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹², inside the model's balanced-pair exception regime — a hole fan would be uninformative, that's the coverage trade.

**Design (computed, `landau-fan.md` step 1 + VTI variant cost regime):**
- **Fast axis**: n = +3.2 → +1.2×10¹² cm⁻² at D = 0 (run-5 cal), **141 pts** (Δn = 1.43×10¹⁰ ≤ half the ray spacing 2.90×10¹⁰ at B_lo = 0.3 T). Vtg +0.984 → +0.411, Vbg +1.166 → +0.425 V — inside validators. n_min = 1.2×10¹²: the ABAB partner needs ≥5 periods, resolvable only for n ≳ 1.35×10¹² (model f_partner); below that columns are exception-regime background — the low-n claim floors there.
- **Slow axis**: **B 10 → 0.3 T uniform in 1/B, Δ(1/B) = 0.0121 T⁻¹ → 269 rows.** Nyquist 41.3 T covers the coherent content observed in run 6 (≤ 32.4 T; ≤7% noise-floor above 36 T) with 2.5× margin on F_L(n_max) = 33.1 T. δF = 0.31 T over the 0.3–10 T record; the binding split (22.1 vs 3×7.1 = 0.8 T) is 2.6·δF. B_lo = 0.3 T = run 6's censored onset lower bound (raising it would kill the harmonic-vs-heavy split; lowering it inflates both axes' floors).
- **Direction**: descending — magnet pre-ramps 0 → 10 T (bare, blocking, ~73 min), fan rides home 10 → 0.3 T and **ends at 0.3 T**. This puts the worst dynamic-range corner (n = 1.2×10¹² × 10 T, measured by run 7: 587 Ω = 12% of FS) **in the first row** — the cheapest possible kill for a sensitivity mistake — and lands the FFT-grade high-B record in the first ~3 h instead of the last.
- **Sensitivity/settling inherited from the spot checks**: sr1 50 µV (5 kΩ FS), τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB; fast_delay = 1.2 s (4τ — the retrace lag is static per column and removed by the per-column background; the residual n-smear is < δF; the 2026-06-14 VTI trilayer fan idiom), slow_delay = 1. Leak trip 1 nA.
- **Price** (calibrated: run 5 fast-axis 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0 → 1.3 s/pt here; runs 6/7 field overhead 3.08 s/row): pre-ramp 73 min + in-fan traverse 71 min + 269 settles 14 min + grid 269×141×1.3 s = 13.7 h + turnaround ~9 min ≈ 16.4 h; realistic **~17.5 h**.

**Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed on the run dir): (1) **first row ~75 min in** (after the pre-ramp): rail/clip across the full n-line at 10 T, leakage, both channels live; (2) **~4 h**: high-B record (B ≳ 2 T, rows 1–33) per-column FFT — heavy-tone F(n) trajectory, the early template read; abort/redesign if the 22.1 T tone is absent across all n; (3) every ~3–4 h: light-tone F(n) on the growing 1/B record, T_sample at base, leakage. Magnet ends at 0.3 T, gates park at 0.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n +3.2 -> +1.2e12 (141) x B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-1/B (269) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_N, N_B = 141, 269
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 1.2, N_N)                 # 1e12 cm^-2, high->low n each row
Ds = np.zeros(N_N)                              # V/nm
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 at D = 0; Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; roundtrip n,D[0] = {calc_nD(Vtgs[0], Vbgs[0], *CAL.values())}")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B, descending 10 -> 0.3 T; D(1/B) = 0.0121 T^-1 (Nyquist 41.3 T) ---
invB = np.linspace(1.0 / 10.0, 1.0 / 0.3, N_B)
B_vec = np.round(1.0 / invB, 4)                 # 10 -> 0.3 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 0.29
print(f"B: {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {N_B} rows uniform-1/B, D(1/B) = {invB[1]-invB[0]:.5f} T^-1")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: pre-ramp starts at 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"

# --- lock-in: fixed for the whole fan (inherited from runs 6/7; worst corner 587 Ohm = 12% FS, run 7) ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> ~10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS); "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.2, 1.0               # 4*tau; retrace lag static per column, < dF after bg removal
I_TRIP = 1e-9

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan electron side: n +3.2 -> +1.2e12 (141 pts) at D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  "B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-1/B (269 rows, D(1/B)=0.0121), sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.2 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('electron side: n = +3.2 -> +1.2e12 cm^-2 (141 pts), D = 0.00 V/nm; B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-1/B, '
              '269 rows D(1/B) = 0.0121 T^-1; cal run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.089e12, D_offset -0.013; '
              'inherits sdh-spot-check runs 6/7 (onset <= 0.3 T censored, Nyq 41.3 T vs content <= 32.4 T)')

# gates to the first point, then the bare positioning ramp 0 -> 10 T (blocking, ~73 min)
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0]); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)
print("pre-ramp 0 -> 10 T (blocking, ~73 min)...")
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
print(f"at B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T; starting fan")

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot(k_bg.volt, k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"fan done/stopped: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T (left there deliberately), gates parked at 0")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T.               f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')

s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
